newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran, Iraq, to hand over remains from 1980-88 war.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Iraq, to hand over remains from 1980-88 war.

text.p: Iran and Iraq will on Thursday exchange the remains of soldiers missing in action in the 1980-1988 Iran-Iraq war, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
IRNA said the remains of 40 Iranians will be handed over by Iraqi officials at Shalamcheh border in southwest Iran.
It quoted a report by the armed forces command headquarters as saying Iran will hand over the bodies of 99 Iraqi soldiers killed in the war.
Iraq and Iran signed an agreement last year on mutual relations and the issue of POWs, those missing in action and remains of soldiers killed during the war.
Both countries have exchanged hundreds of POWS and remains of soldiers. In August, the remains of 400 Iraqis and 65 Iranians were delivered to army officials of the two countries.
